subtasks.text: Build a self-contained Node.js HTTP JSON bookmarks API using only built-in modules. Deliver server.mjs and a README with startup instructions. Listen on process.env.PORT, default 3000, on 0.0.0.0. GET /health returns 200 with {"ok":true}. GET /bookmarks returns an array initially empty. POST /bookmarks accepts JSON with a non-empty title and an http or https URL, returns 201 with a generated id, title and url, or 400 for malformed JSON or invalid fields. DELETE /bookmarks/:id returns 204 for an existing bookmark and 404 otherwise. Unknown routes return 404 JSON. Keep data in memory and require no external services or dependencies.

subtasks.text:
Build an offline dependency-free Node.js 24 HTTP stock-reservation service using durable SQLite (node:sqlite is available). Deliver server.js, package.json with npm test, README and real HTTP subprocess tests. Start: node server.js --db DB --seed SEED.json --port PORT; bind 127.0.0.1, accept port 0, print a JSON line {"port":actualPort} when ready. No UI needed. Seed exactly {items:[{sku,capacity}]}; unique nonempty string SKUs, integer capacity 0..1000000. Initialize a new DB once; restart with the same seed must retain all state and receipts. Use explicit logical time, never wall-clock expiration.

GET /state returns exactly {clock,revision,items,holds}; initially clock=0,revision=0. items are {sku,capacity,available}. holds are {id,expiresAt,status,lines:[{sku,qty}]}; status held|confirmed|cancelled|expired. Sort items by sku, holds by id and aggregated hold lines by sku using JS code-unit order. IDs/SKUs/keys are nonempty strings used literally, including __proto__. GET is read-only; identical state gives identical JSON bytes.

POST /commands accepts only these exact object shapes:
{key,type:"reserve",holdId,ttl,lines:[{sku,qty}]}; ttl and qty integers 1..1000000, lines nonempty. Aggregate repeated SKUs. All SKUs must exist; all aggregated quantities must fit available stock. Atomically reserve the whole bundle or none; holdId must never have existed. expiresAt=clock+ttl. Reserve reduces available.
{key,type:"confirm",holdId}: only a held hold can confirm; it permanently consumes its reserved stock. Availability does not change.
{key,type:"cancel",holdId}: only a held hold can cancel, releasing all stock.
{key,type:"advance",to}: to is integer 0..1000000000 and >=clock. Set clock=to; expire every held hold with expiresAt<=to, releasing stock; never expire confirmed holds. Each successful command increments revision once, even advance to the current clock. Success HTTP200 exactly {ok:true,revision:N}.

Business refusals HTTP409 exactly {error:CODE}: missing_item,

uncovered.requirement: Hold state machine (reserve/confirm/cancel/advance) with logical-clock expiry and atomic multi-SKU bundles
uncovered.label: algorithm/business-rule

uncovered.requirement: Idempotency receipts: canonical JSON comparison (key order ignored, arrays ordered), byte-identical replay before business checks, idempotency_conflict, refused receipts cached
uncovered.label: algorithm/business-rule

uncovered.requirement: Domain change + receipt in one SQLite transaction, surviving SIGKILL and restart
uncovered.label: other

uncovered.requirement: Concurrent requests serialised: no oversell, duplicate application or lost update
uncovered.label: algorithm/business-rule

uncovered.requirement: Executed assertion suite: last-unit contention, same-key retries, restart replay, expiry boundary, confirm/advance order, U+10000 vs U+E000 ordering, __defineGetter__ rejection
uncovered.label: other

uncovered.requirement: README documenting measured results honestly
uncovered.label: content/design authoring

subtasks.text: Write README.md using plate.svg, geometry.json, verify_geometry.py, and the recorded probes as sources. Explain that this is a fictional geometric study rather than manufacturing certification; describe the six primitives and cutout/material interpretation; derive outer area, four-hole area and perimeter, capsule area and perimeter while explicitly distinguishing its 28 mm straight length from its 36 mm overall width; derive material area 5776-52*pi mm^2, total perimeter 376+32*pi mm, centroid (60,40) mm by symmetry, and minimum clearance 7 mm.
